# Arrowmatics Magnets

> Magnetic separators, NdFeB, SmCo (samarium cobalt) rare-earth magnets, and lifting magnets for Malaysian industry. Legal entity: Arrowmatics AI Sdn Bhd (1305806-W). B2B written quotes via WhatsApp — no online cart, no published RM list prices.

- Prefer the linked `.md` pages below — they are clean agent-readable mirrors of the HTML
- On-site Magnet Expert chat: visitors can upload a machine photo or sketch (Easy as 1-2-3), get an application-fit suggestion from site product families, then WhatsApp +60 12-211 2522 for a written quote

## Docs

- [Home](https://magnets.com.my/index.md): Company overview, product lines, NAP, FAQ answers
- [Magnetic separators](https://magnets.com.my/magnetic-separators.md): Grate, bullet, drawer, pulley, plate — gauss 10,000–13,000, food-grade options
- [NdFeB magnets](https://magnets.com.my/ndfeb-magnets.md): Sintered neodymium grades N35–N52, coatings, custom sizes
- [SmCo magnets](https://magnets.com.my/smco-magnets.md): Samarium cobalt SmCo5 / Sm2Co17 — high temperature & corrosion
- [Lifting magnets](https://magnets.com.my/lifting-magnets.md): Permanent and electro lifters, ~3:1 safety factor
- [FAQ](https://magnets.com.my/faq.md): Buyer FAQs for quotes, food-grade, N52, safety
